title: rhodiola algida
intro: Rhodiola algida, commonly known as Arctic rhodiola, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Crassulaceae. It is native to the Arctic tundra regions of Asia and Europe, where it grows in areas with permafrost. The health benefits of Rhodiola algida include its adaptogenic properties, which help to reduce stress and anxiety, improve mental performance, and enhance mood. The therapeutic actions of Rhodiola algida are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including rosavin, salidroside, and tyrosol, which have been shown to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective effects.
